_comment: Retraining policy (RETRAINING_STRATEGY.md). Report-only: src.retraining evaluates and recommends; it never trains, promotes or changes serving. Values marked null need a business decision and keep every gate closed until set.

artifacts._note: Every existing artifact directory is immutable; new candidates need a new versioned directory.

triggers._note: Drift thresholds, min_samples and sustained_minutes come from drift_config.json (PSI bands are uncalibrated heuristics). Drift alone can only lead to investigation.

labels._note: min_labels matches src.ml_performance.MIN_LABELS. min_fraud_labels is a placeholder, not a calibrated value: with 30 fraud labels a measured recall of 0.90 has a Wilson 95% interval of 0.74-0.97, so only large drops are detectable. More fraud labels narrow it.

performance_gates._note: Business-approved limits do not exist yet. null = business_decision_required: a gate that is null never passes.

training_data._note: Prediction events deliberately carry no amounts or balances (src/events.py RESPONSE_FIELDS), so they can be evaluated but not trained on. A point-in-time raw-feature log needs a privacy/data-owner decision. Untagged rows are never treated as production training data: before tagging existed, 10.6M untagged events were load tests (Phase 1).

justification_required.exceeds_orig_bal: PaySim legitimate transfers exceed the sender balance 90% of the time (Phase 2 R4); show the feature is valid on realistic traffic.
